generation: 4th gen (MQ4); 1.6T + 13.8 kWh battery PHEV; 3-row; standard AWD

overview: The Sorento Plug-in Hybrid is the three-row PHEV variant — same 1.6T+13.8 kWh battery as the Sportage PHEV but in a longer, taller body with three rows. Combined output 261 hp / 258 lb-ft, standard AWD, 32 mi EPA all-electric range, 74 MPGe combined / 33 mpg in hybrid mode. Two trims (EX, SX Prestige) for MY2025; MY2026 renames SX Prestige to X-Line SX Prestige with X-Line appearance package standard. Source: https://www.kia.com/us/en/sorento-plug-in-hybrid , https://www.kiamedia.com/us/en/models/sorento-phev/2025/specifications
